title: Vector Norm and Unit Vector
learning_objectives: Compute L1, L2 and L∞ norms
Normalise a vector to unit length
hints: L1: `sum(abs(x) for x in v)`; L∞: `max(abs(x) for x in v)` (watch the empty case).
L2: `math.sqrt(sum(x * x for x in v))`.
In `unit`, compute `n = norm(v)` once and raise if `n == 0`.

failure_feedback.advice: Take the maximum of absolute values, not of raw values.
Raise ValueError before dividing by a zero norm.
Return 0.0 for an empty vector (max() of an empty list raises).
